entities.name: Extended CAG information list
entities.description: An information element that the network may include to assign a new CAG information list to the UE or delete the CAG information list at the UE side.

entities.name: User Equipment
entities.description: The mobile device that supports Extended CAG information list functionality.

entities.name: Network
entities.description: The network entity that may include the Extended CAG information list IE.

entities.name: CAG information list
entities.description: The list of Closed Access Group information that can be assigned to or deleted from the UE.

entities.name: UE supports Extended CAG information list
entities.description: Condition that the UE must support Extended CAG information list functionality for the network to include this IE.

relations.description: The network may include the Extended CAG information list IE in messages.
Inclusion of the Extended CAG information list IE is conditional on UE support.
The Extended CAG information list IE can assign a new CAG information list to the UE or delete the existing CAG information list.
